dialogues.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
dialogues.text: What!? What's going on!? How could they have defeated all my Fungi in just the blink of an eye!? What am I gonna tell the others...

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Huh? What are you two doing here? Are you here to mock me!?

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Don't celebrate just yet! I'll win it all back next time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Next time? Paimon thought we only had one shot in the preliminaries?

choices.text: Maybe she meant the next season.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, that's a good thing. No need to take a single loss too hard!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, strange Ajilenakh Nut girl, Paimon is looking forward to our next fight!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Hmph, I'll be the one to comfort you guys next time!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: And if you guys aren't too mean about it, I might even consider sharing a few Candied Ajilenakh Nuts with you to make you feel better.

choices.text: She's still got some fight in her.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Golden Comet and Silver Companion won!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Erm... The Fungi react to each other's skills. I may have been careless and forgotten about that.

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: It's dangerous to charge in without a plan. I'll keep that in mind from now on!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Whatever the case, my companions and I will make adjustments to our strategy and definitely beat you next time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm? You're speaking as if we're gonna go up against each other again...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The competition will probably have more than one season.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, that makes sense. Hopefully, she'll be as passionate as she is now in the next season.

choices.text: Don't feel too sad about it...

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: I—I'm not sad! You just wait! I'll win it all back!
